name: Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited
summary: Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates an online healthcare services platform in China. It offers online diagnosis and treatment, online consultation services, audio and video consultations, standardized healthcare service packages, health check-ups, genetic testing, concierge services, health management services, smart device sales, and consulting services. The company also provides online consultation, hospital referral and appointment, inpatient arrangement, and second opinion services; prepaid cards and health check-up services.
